title: How is it going recently?
simplified_paragraphs: A：乐乐最近在学校怎么样？
B：他喜欢帮助大家，同学们也很喜欢他，但是最近学习马马虎虎。
A：他学习不努力，每天回家就喜欢看电视。
B：明天他来学校，我也跟他说说这个事。
traditional_paragraphs: A：樂樂最近在學校怎麼樣？
B：他喜歡幫助大家，同學們也很喜歡他，但是最近學習馬馬虎虎。
A：他學習不努力，每天回家就喜歡看電視。
B：明天他來學校，我也跟他說說這個事。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： Lǐ lǎo shī， hǎo jiǔ bù jiàn！
B： Lè lè mā ma， hǎo jiǔ bù jiàn！
A： Lè lè zuì jìn zài xué xiào zěn me yàng？
B： tā xǐ huan bāng zhù dà jiā， tóng xué men yě hěn xǐ huan tā， dàn shì zuì jìn xué xí mǎ ma hū hū。
A： tā xué xí bù nǔ lì， měi tiān huí jiā jiù xǐ huan kàn diàn shì。
B： kàn tài duō diàn shì bù hǎo。
A： shì ya。 wǒ shuō le， tā bù tīng。
B： míng tiān tā lái xué xiào， wǒ yě gēn tā shuō shuō zhè gè shì。
A： tài hǎo le！ xiè xie Lǐ lǎo shī。
english_paragraphs: A: Teacher Li, long time no see!
B: Lele’s mother, long time no see!
A: How is Lele doing at school recently?
B: He likes to help everyone, and his classmates also like him very much, but his studies have been so-so recently.
A: He doesn’t study hard and likes to watch TV every day when he comes home.
B: Watching too much TV is not good.
A: Yes. I told him, but he didn't listen.
B: He’s coming to school tomorrow. I’ll talk to him about it too.
A: Great! Thank you, Teacher Li.
